notes.title: Pizza Kidd has been selected for the INDIE EXCHANGE FALL SHOWCASE 2025!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899580/84eac98be7ca1af031531c7697c7241b7958d02f.png"][/img]
[/p][p]We’re excited to share some more great news — [i]Pizza Kidd[/i] has officially been selected for the [b]@indieexchange MIX Fall Showcase 2025[/b]! 🎉
[/p][p]This is an incredible opportunity to showcase our game alongside other amazing indie titles, and we can’t wait for you to experience what we’ve been cooking up... 

[url="https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/the-mix-fall-game-showcase-2025"]https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/the-mix-fall-game-showcase-2025[/url]

[b]When & Where[/b][/p][p]📅 August 29, 2025[/p][p]⏰ 9:00 AM PST[/p][p]📺 Live on [b]Twitch + YouTube[/b] (Media Indie Exchange channels)
[/p][p]🍕 [b]What’s Pizza Kidd?[/b]
A hand-drawn 2D beat ’em up that fuses the hard-hitting action of classic arcade brawlers with the style and flair of fighting games. Step into the shoes of Kidd, team up with his sister Roze and loyal dog MUDD, and battle grotesque biotech monsters created by the villainous Santos Corps.
[/p][p]🔥 [b]Play the Demo Today![/b]
Our latest demo is live and ready for you to jump in. This is just a taste of what’s to come — more stages, bosses, and secrets are waiting in the full release.
[/p][p]🎮 [b]Join the Fight, Back the project![/b]
Your support means everything. Add Pizza Kidd to your wishlist, try the demo, early sign-up on our Kickstarter page and spread the word to help us grow this community together.

[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pizzakidd/pizza-kidd-2d-pixel-punchfest-with-monsters-and-mayhem"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pizzakidd/pizza-kidd-2d-pixel-punchfest-with-monsters-and-mayhem[/url]
[/p][p]#PizzaKidd #IndieGame #TheMix #GameDev #BeatEmUp #Steam #WishlistIt #Kickstarter[/p]

notes.content:
[p]Among 50+ indie titles at this year’s Indie Game Showcase, [i]Pizza Kidd[/i] took home [b]2 major awards[/b]:[/p][p]🏆 [i]Best Fighting / Beat ‘Em Up Game[/i]
🏆 [i]Best in Modern Retro[/i]
🎮 [i]Nominated for Best in Show

[/i][url="https://toomanygames.com/introducing-the-first-ever-toomanygames-indie-game-awards/"]https://toomanygames.com/introducing-the-first-ever-toomanygames-indie-game-awards/[/url][/p][p]—

Let’s keep cooking and be sure to follow the project on KickStarter. 🍕

notes.title: Pizza Kidd: Too Many Games 2025 Indie Showcase
Ho-Ho-Holiday Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899580/c6ccb582b2415000634a1e4cd916a41b48f42a18.png[/img]

🎄 Hello Holiday Update!

Ho-ho-hello, Pizza Kidd fans! 🎅🍕 It’s that time of year again—where we don't just deck the halls while devouring mom's cookies, we deck monsters while devouring pizza!

Since Pizza Kidd's Steam Scream October release, we’ve been working harder than Santa’s elves on double espresso shots to bring you some much needed festive fixes and fiery fast updates. So, grab a hot cocoa (or a slice of hot pizza), and check out what’s cooking in the Kidd Games' oven!

[b]Here’s what’s new in Pizza Kidd[/b]

🔧 Latest Updates:

• Temp Run/Dash + Heavy Punch Attack Added (more tweaks / animation coming)
• Super Moves Update: Super moves are now unblockable by Baku & Haku enemies
• Enemy Adjustments: Lumaca & Siput’s "push boxes" are deactivated when attacking for smoother gameplay.
• Fullscreen Options Improved: Now includes Fullscreen Borderless Window mode for more display flexibility.

🪳 Bug Fixes:

• Block/Guard retreat (hop-step) while facing Left is now fixed.
• Right SHIFT button (for block/guard) on the keyboard is now functional.

🌟 Help Us Grow!

We’re so grateful for the support of our amazing community. Here’s how you can keep helping us make Pizza Kidd even better:

Share the game with your friends and encourage them to wishlist it on Steam!

Follow us on Twitter and Discord for sneak peeks, updates, and behind-the-scenes content.

[b]Kickstarter Campaign Coming Soon[/b]

Be on the lookout for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign and help make the next stage of Pizza Kidd a reality!

We’re super psyched about what’s to come in 2025 and can’t wait to share more updates with you. Have a fantastic holiday season, and thank you for being part of the Pizza Kidd journey!

(and remember to "be good for goodness sake! See you in 2025! 🎄👾)

🎮✨ – The Kidd Games Team

notes.title: Unleash the Power of the Kidd Kata Engine in the Rebuilt Pizza Kidd Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899580/8e6fb47f93665160ae0e6ac832055724cfc435f4.jpg[/img]

Hey all... 

We’ve completely rebuilt Pizza Kidd from the ground up with a brand-new combat system (Kidd Kata Engine), gorgeous, redrawn pixel sprites, and tons of new unique enemies! The updated combo system is smoother, faster, and more fun than ever—get ready to unleash epic moves and take on a fresh wave of challenges!

🔥 Don’t miss out on the action! Add Pizza Kidd to your wishlist and be the first to play when we launch at STEAM SCREAM FEST on October 28th, 2024! 🔥

Stay connected with us on Twitter and join the discussion on Discord. More exciting updates are coming your way!

[url=https://twitter.com/KiddPizza]Pizza Kidd on Twitter[/url]

Thanks so much for your time and support,
 Kidd Games
